items.title: 《使命召唤21：黑色行动6》反作弊负责人揭秘：为何动视对疑似作弊玩家采取“影子封禁”而非立即永封？

others.title: 《使命召唤》反作弊负责人透露为何动视影子禁止涉嫌作弊的玩家而不是立即永久禁止他们

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/rhELrxbucgeqEBl.png
使命召唤21：黑色行动6 反作弊系统高级总监解释了为什么 Activision 会对玩家实施影子禁令，而不是直接将他们从游戏中永久封禁。
多年来，关于作弊以及在像 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 这样的大作中实施反作弊一直存在很多摩擦。游戏中的反作弊并不完美；它会犯错并误封不该被封禁的人，在启动游戏时（如安全启动等）可能会引发麻烦，而且一些玩家会被放入模糊的“受限匹配”池中，即所谓的影子禁令。
反作弊的运作方式一直充满神秘感。使命召唤21：黑色行动6 游戏安全高级总监 David Andrews 介绍了 Ricochet 反作弊系统的更多细节。在采访中，他被问及为什么 Activision 选择对涉嫌作弊的玩家进行影子禁令，而不是简单地当场封禁他们。
Andrews 表示：“我们会将可疑账号放入受限匹配中，以便在进行其他检查或等待其他数据时将他们隔离。我们正在对该账号进行更全面的审查过程，看看究竟发生了什么。这是一种权宜之计，可以在不造成永久性影响或对该账号及玩家产生不可撤销影响的情况下立即移除他们，这为我们提供了喘息的空间来查明账号的情况，如果只是虚惊一场，则可以将他们恢复到正常玩家群体中。”
Andrews 接着指出，Activision 有多种处理涉嫌作弊者的方法，但使用影子禁令等技术可以潜在地引导玩家行为修正，并让他们有机会在没有问题的情况下继续游戏。

“我们还通过受限匹配进行了一些行为修正，告诉玩家：‘嘿，你不能再进行刚才的那种行为，如果你停止，你就可以回来。’ 我们有很多执法手段。我们有受限匹配、排位赛封禁、远程游玩封禁、临时和永久账号停封，还有硬件封禁。我们可以做各种各样的事情，每当处理特定风格或类型的作弊时，我们都会评估哪种方式对这群作弊者更有意义。他们能被引导回归吗？我们最终对此有 100% 的信心吗？是否需要更多研究？无论情况如何，我们都会找出合适的处理方法。”
使命召唤21：黑色行动6: Modern Warfare 4 将于下个月发布，Infinity Ward 旨在积极听取玩家反馈。反作弊是 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 游戏形象的重要组成部分，团队在最近的测试中测试了 Ricochet 在 MW4 中的实施情况。虽然这确实导致了一名职业选手被误封，但 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 通讯团队纠正了这一问题并确认这是一个错误。
使命召唤21：黑色行动6 一直饱受作弊困扰，尤其是在免费下载的大逃杀游戏 使命召唤：战区2 中。Activision 为此投入了大量的时间、金钱和精力，甚至在法庭上起诉作弊软件制作者，尽管与所有游戏开发商一样，它在反作弊战争中仍面临着艰巨的挑战。

items.title: Wardogs 将登陆 Xbox 和 PS5 平台，但仍需等待一段时间

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/JDUwWYbucgeqgas.png
Wardogs，这款在 Steam 上爆红的全新全面战争 FPS 游戏，已正式宣布将登陆主机平台……但还需要一段时间。
作为发布计划的一部分，Wardogs 背后的开发团队 Bulkhead 确认将把这款大规模射击游戏带到主机平台。该游戏预计于 2028 年登陆 Xbox 和 PS5，但从今天起已在 Steam 上开启抢先体验。游戏首发售价为 39.99 美元，并计划随着游戏内容的扩充而涨价。此举旨在回馈在早期阶段支持游戏的粉丝，而不是对一款未完成的产品收取 60 至 70 美元的全价。
“Wardogs 雄心勃勃，虽然目前还不够完善，仍有很长的路要走，但这 balanced 才是抢先体验应有的样子，”Bulkhead 首席执行官 Joe Brammer 表示。“我们将游戏交到玩家手中，倾听他们的反馈，并承担必要的风险将其打造成能够长久发展的作品。最重要的是，我们希望玩家能联机互动、彼此交流，找回我们成长过程中玩 FPS 游戏的那种乐趣。”
这一切都表明 Wardogs 可能将 1.0 正式版的发布目标定在 2028 年，因为与 Xbox 不同，PlayStation 对其平台上的抢先体验游戏筛选极其严格。像 深海迷航2 这样的大作在抢先体验阶段也不得不跳过 PS5，虽然也有例外，但我目前对 Wardogs 成为这些例外之一并不抱太大希望。
深海迷航2
深海, 恐怖
查看更多 立即下载
同样有趣的是，Bulkhead 明确确认了 PS5 为发布平台，而外界普遍推测 PlayStation 6 将于明年发布。该游戏是否会有原生的 PS6 版本仍有待观察，但如果支持向下兼容功能，推测它应该可以在次世代主机上运行。
Wardogs 是 2026 年最令人惊喜的游戏之一，因为它实际上是在今年夏天营销活动升温时才崭露头角的。然而，参与测试的玩家反响热烈，预示着射击游戏领域未来可能会迎来另一位强有力的竞争者。

items.title: GTA 4 曾是 Xbox 360 对抗 PS3 的“动真格”时刻

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/lmLlBPbucgbBDte.png
这是 Ryan McCaffrey 的观点文章，他在 2002 年至 2012 年初代 Xbox 和 Xbox 360 时代曾在《官方 Xbox 杂志》工作，之后加入媒体并一直担任“Xbox 专家”。在 Xbox 25 周年到来之际，他将分享他在该平台第一个四分之一世纪里的回忆。

随着备受期待的 GTA6 距离发售仅剩两个多月时间，回想不久前 Grand Theft Auto V 传承版 系列还是 PlayStation 独占游戏是很值得的。GTA 3 和 侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市 直到 2003 年 11 月才以 GTA Double Pack 的形式登陆初代 Xbox，这意味着 GTA 3 在 PS2 上独占了两年，侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市 独占了一年。与此同时，Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition 于 2005 年 6 月登陆 Xbox，比最初的 PS2 版本晚了相对较短的八个月。
侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市
角色扮演, 经营, RPG, 道具收费
查看更多 立即下载

关键在于，当当时的 Xbox 负责人 Peter Moore——可以说是经营 Xbox 业务以来最出色的表演者——在 2006 年 E3 展上卷起袖子，露出二头肌上的 Grand Theft Auto V 传承版 IV 标志“纹身”，并宣布 Rockstar 的次世代 GTA 不仅会在 Xbox 360 上同步发售，而且 Xbox 还将获得两个限时独占的扩展包（后来证明是优秀的 The Lost and Damned 和绝对顶级的 The Ballad of Gay Tony）时，这在当时是一件天大的事。Microsoft 为此特权向 Rockstar 支付了 5000 万美元的支票，但这钱花得值。至少对 Xbox 360 玩家来说是这样，在 2006 年 E3 展 Xbox 新闻发布会之前，以及 PS3 发售之前，许多玩家就已经投资了这款率先上市的高清时代次世代主机，因为 使命召唤：战区2、上古卷轴IV：湮灭重制版、幽灵行动：尖峰战士2 和 Fight Night Round 3 等游戏都已经证明了其强大的次世代实力。
使命召唤：战区2

查看更多 立即下载
Microsoft 取得了巨大的开局（正如 Moore 常说的，“第一个达到 1000 万的就赢了”），通过这次 GTA 4 交易，公司表明它站在了早期“加入”Xbox 360 的数百万玩家一边。在面对行业最大的特许经营权时，Xbox 360 玩家不会成为二等公民。
在我看来，GTA 4 是所有极具讽刺意味的 GTA 游戏中最好笑的一部。

当 GTA 4 最终在 2008 年 4 月发布时（在 2007 年秋季跳票后），它当然是一部从头开始打造的杰作，从技术上讲，它与 GTA 3 三部曲没有任何共同点。它带我们回到了 Liberty City，尽管这是一个完全重塑的城市，看起来令人难以置信，而且充满了小细节和可做的事情。在我看来，它是所有讽刺天才的 GTA 游戏中最好笑的一部，因为它拥有搞笑的游戏内互联网（可以在网吧访问……还记得那些吗？）、令人难忘的角色如 Brucie，以及让人捧腹大笑的游戏内电视节目如“The Men’s Room”。

就个人而言，它发售时正值我离婚后不久，我有着非常有意义的回忆：我最好的朋友 Robert 在游戏发售后立即从亚利桑那州飞过来陪我，和我一起享受游戏。当然，那时还没有 GTA Online，所以我们就轮流交换手柄，每个人都为拿着手柄的人所做的疯狂举动而狂欢（并大笑）。在他陪我的那几天里，我们一定在 GTA 4 中投入了几十个小时，我永远会将 GTA 4 与我在最需要的时候所获得的一点点乐趣、轻松和友谊联系在一起。

后来，正如我提到的，The Lost and Damned 发布了（并在 Xbox 上独占了一年多），它对同名机车帮的关注是典型 GTA 配方的超级酷的转型。再后来，The Ballad of Gay Tony（六个月的 Xbox 360 独占）展示了 Rockstar 无可挑剔的叙事和角色塑造；嘿，我个人会将其列为有史以来任何游戏最好的 DLC 或扩展包之一。然后在 Xbox 360 世代的末尾，我们迎来了 GTA 5……但遗憾的是，完全没有最初承诺的单人 DLC，更不用说独占 DLC 了。

无论如何，我认为 GTA 4 在 Xbox 360 上的同步发售以及随后的独占 DLC 可能是 Xbox 品牌从文化角度来看的巅峰时期。你必须拥有一台 Xbox 360——如果不是为了它已经拥有的强大游戏阵容，那就是为了独占的 GTA 4 扩展包。它与 2007 年 光环3 的发售旗鼓相当。事实上，从 2007 年秋季（见证了 光环3、Mass Effect、生化奇兵 2、Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare、摇滚乐队3 和 刺客信条4：黑旗 记忆重置 的发售）到 2008 年 4 月 GTA 4 的发售，可能是任何主机历史上最辉煌的六个月左右。

items.title: 《Professor Layton and the Curious Village Remake》正式公布，将于2027年登陆多个平台

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/TtxrGkbucgbBfiq.png
系列开发商 Level-5 宣布了 Professor Layton and the Curious Village Remake。
雷顿教授与不可思议的小镇
休闲竞技
查看更多 立即下载
在今天的 Level-5 Vision 2026 发布会上，这款经典解谜游戏的全新版本正式公开，将于 2027 年的某个时间点登陆 Nintendo Switch、Switch 2、PC（Steam）以及 PlayStation 5 平台。
新闻稿指出，重制版的角色已以 3D 形式重新构想，而圣谜团镇的世界也变得更具沉浸感，拥有更强的深度和更丰富的细节。Professor Layton and the Curious Village 的动画过场也经过了翻新，支持更高的分辨率和宽屏格式。
明年将是 Professor Layton and the Curious Village 在 Nintendo DS 上最初发布 20 周年。该作开启了一个系列，目前已涵盖了以赫谢尔·雷顿教授及其助手路克·特莱顿为主角的两个三部曲游戏，以及更多的衍生作品和与 逆转裁判5 的难忘联动。
逆转裁判5
益智, 解谜, 冒险
查看更多 立即下载
当然，一款全新的雷顿教授游戏也即将到来：Professor Layton and the New World of Steam 定于 12 月 10 日在 Switch、PC 和 PS5 平台上发布。
之后会有更多的重制版吗？这可能取决于 Professor Layton and the Curious Village 的表现。但对于任何想要在现代硬件上体验该系列起源的玩家来说，这个重制版最终可能非常值得一看。

items.title: 动作RPG《疾风之刃》上线港澳台 版号申请中

content.v: Valofe于近日宣布，动作RPG《疾风之刃》（Kritika）在中国台湾、中国香港、澳门地区正式上线。
疾风之刃
奇幻, 动作
《疾风之刃》公测版本一开始共有4个职业供大家选择，分别是千月姬、控魔师、刃武者、剑斗士，而人物在15级后可以转职，届时又有2到3条路线可以选择，也就是说游戏其实共有11个职业。
查看更多 立即下载
Valofe在正式上线前，面向当地玩家进行了检查游戏内容与运营体系的测试。据Valofe称，7月结束的测试中，次日留存率平均约65%，平均游戏时长约4小时。
正式服务将应用反映测试参与者意见的改进事项，包括提升游戏整体易用性、调整内容平衡等，对主要系统进行了改进。
Valofe表示，已与当地发行商菲尼克斯网络科技共享玩家反应与数据，并将其反映到更新中，构建了符合地区特色的内容与运营体系。
同时也在推进进军中国大陆。Valofe称，已与当地合作伙伴一起申请了《疾风之刃》的版号审查，由上海子公司主导开发。公司表示相关行政程序正在进行中，年内获得版号的可能性较高。
此外，还通过中国厂商开发《疾风之刃 Mobile》（暂定名），计划于2027年上半年上线。
Valofe相关人士表示：“基于与上海开发工作室及发行商凤凰游戏的合作，我们得以向当地玩家提供完成度更高的《疾风之刃》服务。将以此次正式上线为契机，在提供稳定服务的同时，持续扩大服务地区。”

items.title: Palworld 出版负责人担心抢先体验已经“失去了意义”，因为“超休闲”游戏文化的兴起意味着人们常常不明白他们正在玩什么
items.summary: "People just buy an early access game like they buy a normal game and treat it like that's the game."

content.v: Early access on Steam is a simple concept. You buy a game before it's finished, provide bug reports and feedback to developers, and help shape a project's direction and ambitions. Everybody wins: You get to play the game early, and developers earn money that helps them continue and finish their work. It's been a boon for numerous notable games over the years, including Baldur's Gate 3 and Palworld .

In an interview with GamesRadar , though, Pocketpair communications and publishing chief John Buckley said that proposition is becoming increasingly difficult for developers, because the whole idea of early access has "lost its meaning."

"Go back to the Steam Greenlight days, when Steam changed Greenlight to early access, there were a few years where it really was running and operating exactly the way I think Steam dreamed it," Buckley said.

"I think everyone knew what they were in for. The kind of people who were buying early access games knew what they were in for. They were the kind of gamers who want to be involved, they want to give feedback, they want to talk to devs. It was this really beautiful golden era."

Now, though, the rise of what Buckley called "hyper-casual mobile culture, and hyper-casual gaming culture, and live service gaming culture" has eroded that understanding, and the accord between developer and gamer that rose from it: "The culture has changed and early access, essentially, has lost its meaning. People just buy an early access game like they buy a normal game and treat it like that's the game."

There's no doubt some truth to that. Generally speaking, I subscribe to the principle that if a product is offered for sale, and people pay money for that product, they're well within their rights to expect that they're getting the product. But early access isn't quite so cut-and-dried: Steam Greenlight was a more cumbersome system, but it also clearly delineated between a work-in-progress and a final release, which early access releases often do not.

Dialed-in gamers, or those who are old enough to remember when beta testing was an actual phase of development rather than a promotional tool, may have a clearer idea of what to expect from early access games. But as gaming becomes more of a mainstream pastime it's reasonable to expect that an increasing percentage of the audience is going to neither know nor care about what early access: They just want to buy a game and play it.

Buckley doesn't believe that's necessarily a bad thing, but he did say "it's getting harder on Steam, sadly, because this culture has come through." And while he remains a believer, he also acknowledged that early access isn't ideal for every game, and that the system is "abused" by some developers.

"The biggest way it's abused now is just like, 'We'll release it now because we need money'," he said. "It's a way now to sidestep traditional funding means. It's almost become the new Kickstarter in some ways. Put out the build to get the money."

I'm not entirely sold on the idea that "put out the build to get the money" really qualifies as abuse—it is, after all, the whole basis for the early access system. But it can lead to trouble if early access sales aren't enough to support continued development, or simply through mismanaged expectations. The best thing developers who release into early access can do to avoid potential headaches, Buckley said, is to be clear about what's happening and, as much as possible, keep people fully informed.

"All we can do is try to softly educate people. I think we do an okay job. I think we try to be quite transparent. 'Hey guys, the next update's a while away. It's not going to be content-heavy, it's going to be QOL-heavy.' We try to balance it."

Pocketpair has indeed taken that approach with its fans: Buckley recently warned his followers not to expect too much from Palworld's 1.1 patch, saying it's "not planning to spend a year making a massive update."

items.title: 《神偷》设计师认为 2010 年的《心灵杀手》应该结束图形军备竞赛：“保真度曲线已经变得令人震惊”
items.summary: "Why do we need more graphics? Because they just cost a ton."

content.v: Thief designer Randy Smith Evergreen, whose credits also include System Shock 2 and Dark Messiah: Might and Magic, thinks we need to chill out a bit when it comes to the graphics arms race. Specifically, he reckons the race should have stopped 16 years ago with Remedy's original Alan Wake, which was quite a looker back in the day.

"The fidelity curve has become outrageous," he tells us. "It's become a spectacle. I remember it was back when Alan Wake came out that I was like, 'OK, this is relatively photoreal. I know 100% that I'm on a ferry. I see that I'm going to an island in the Pacific Northwest. Why do we need more graphics? Because they just cost a ton.' Like, I 100% get it. I've got the vibe. It feels right. What else are we doing with this graphics arms race, right?"

Quite a lot, it turns out. We had high-fidelity graphics that started to look photorealistic, but then it was decided that we needed lighting and reflections that looked better than real. None of these things serve any practical purpose, but now most games that fall into the AA or AAA categories feature ray tracing and a level of fidelity that's not possible to enjoy—for most people—without DLSS trickery.

"I think Alan Wake is the fidelity everything needs to hit," Smith Evergreen says. "Where you're like, I get it. I get your vibes. I can tell what's going on, and everything beyond that is gravy. Sure, would they prefer an immersive sim that's got insane spectacle and gorgeous, Arkane Lyon quality vistas? Of course they would like that. But is it necessary for what you came to an immersive sim for? I'm not sure that it is."
This ties into his belief that immersive sims shouldn't be aiming for AAA —it misunderstands the audience, specifically its size. It's just not enough to justify the cost of development.

"Like, you just have to put more money into them," he said, "make a bigger and bigger immersive sim. It's got to be AAA, and it's got to sit right alongside Ghost of Tsushima and GTA 6, and it's got to be a game that's big enough to capture the public's attention. But I think that might be a misread for the audience size of immersive sims."
This isn't something anybody is worrying about when it comes to Nightdive's Thief remaster , which won't be yassifying The City. Judging by what we've seen so far, it looks a lot like OG Thief.

"I'm super excited to see what they do," says Smith Evergreen. "Nightdive seems very trustworthy, very passionate. I like the projects they're choosing to remaster. So that's going to be awesome to see.

"In a way, I'll be able to play Thief again for the first time ever. I used to say that when I played Dishonored, that was the first time I ever played a Thief game. Because when you make a game, it's just a totally different experience than having played it. But I feel like enough time has passed since I played Thief: The Dark Project that playing a remaster will probably feel very fresh for me. So I'm excited about that."
We're still waiting for a Thief: The Dark Project Remastered release date, and Smith Evergreen is currently working on a project that "you'll hear about before too long".

items.summary: The next wave of monthly games for Amazon Luna has been revealed, and if you're a fan of first-person shooters

content.v: The next wave of monthly games for Amazon Luna has been revealed, and if you're a fan of first-person shooters, then you're in for a treat. The headline act is Doom Eternal , or if you'd prefer your guns to be chatterboxes, you can also grab the delightfully weird High on Life. Luna members can also stream Star Wars Outlaws later this month for open-world action set in a galaxy far (far!) away, or they can explore the alien world of Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora right now.

Several new GameNight titles will also be available throughout the month, so if you're in the mood for some social gaming, you can check out kaiju-powered board game fun in King of Tokyo, test your general knowledge in Quiz Time: Guinness World Records, aim for a strike in Bowling Mayhem, and explore Cranium Planet.

As part of its September update, Amazon Luna is also introducing a Remote Play feature . This will allow people to play games together--even if they aren’t in the same room--and it should work nicely with the multiplayer titles featured in the Luna streaming library.

As mentioned above, you can download some pretty good action games, and if you want to experience the formative years of Doom, you can also check out the first two games in the franchise. Botany Manor is also recommended as it offers both a chance to flex your brain muscles and your green thumb. Rims Racing is a rock-solid motorbike simulator, and Just Die Already is an "old people mayhem sandbox game" from the team behind the Goat Simulator series. Several of these games are already available to claim, and the rest will roll out in weekly waves.

items.title: Amazon Luna 在云游戏艰难的一个月内推出了迄今为止最雄心勃勃的功能
items.summary: As part of its September update, Amazon Luna introduced a Remote Play feature that lets people play games toge

content.v: As part of its September update, Amazon Luna introduced a Remote Play feature that lets people play games together, even if they aren't in the same room.

If you haven't heard of it, Luna is Amazon's cloud gaming service for Prime subscribers that lets them access and play a catalog of games without the need for a console or PC. While some Luna games have had multiplayer features, you previously needed to be in the same room with others to play those titles.

Remote Play intends to solve that by letting Amazon Prime and Luna Premium subscribers invite up to seven others into their sessions. These other players won't need an Amazon Prime subscription to use Remote Play, although they will need to use Luna's website or TV app. Of course, you'll now be relying on the smooth internet connections of even more players to comfortably use Remote Play, but the same goes for similar features on PS5 or Nintendo Switch 2.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Amazon-Luna.png?w=636

To promote Remote Play, Amazon also released two new multiplayer-focused games today. One is a digital version of the board game King of Tokyo, while the other is It's Quiz Time: Guinness World Records, a competitive trivia game. Later in September, it will add the motion-controlled Bowling Mayhem and Pictionary-like Cranium Planet to the game catalog. Star Wars Outlaws and Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora were also added to the Luna Standard game lineup today, although those are single-player games.

This Remote Play update is one of the most substantial additions to Amazon Luna in some time, and it arrives in a month that hasn't been so great for cloud gaming. Last week, Xbox confirmed it will limit Game Pass Ultimate subscribers to just 15 hours of cloud gaming a month and make them pay extra for anything beyond that.
As Amazon Luna is included with Prime and just got this Remote Play feature, that makes it a little bit more alluring as a cloud gaming option.

items.summary: The perfect place to spend my life with fleas and parasites. The Binding of Isaac is perhaps the greatest rogu

content.v: The perfect place to spend my life with fleas and parasites.

The Binding of Isaac is perhaps the greatest roguelike ever made, or at the very least, I wouldn't argue with anyone who felt that way. So when developer and indie-game legend Edmund McMillen said that it was merely a basic roguelike to get his feet into the water before creating Mewgenics , my interest was certainly piqued. But 13 years after its announcement, Mewgenics arrived on PC earlier this year, and there was no way it could live up to the expectations after that long… Right? I'll let it already being my second-most played game ever on Steam behind Isaac do the talking.

Teaming up with The End Is Nigh co-developer Tyler Glaiel, Mewgenics is perhaps McMillen's strangest game to date – which is saying something. Here's the elevator pitch: you breed countless messed up cats in your home before sending them out to war in a roguelike tactical RPG, with classes, mechanics, and stats ripped right out of Dungeons & Dragons . It's messed up, it's hilarious, it's macabre, it's wildly inappropriate, and most of all it's just a phenomenal strategy game.

items.title: 《战狗》即将登陆 Xbox 和 PS5，但还需要一段时间
items.summary: Wardogs, a new all-out warfare FPS game that has been blowing up on Steam, is officially coming to consoles...

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/10/wardogsthumb-1789046591629.png
Wardogs , a new all-out warfare FPS game that has been blowing up on Steam, is officially coming to consoles... but it'll be a while.

As part of its launch, the team behind Wardogs, Bulkhead, confirmed that it will bring the massive shooter to consoles. The game is slated to arrive on Xbox and PS5 in 2028, but is available in early access on Steam starting today. The game is launching for $39.99, with plans to increase the price as the game expands. The idea is to reward fans who support the game in its earliest stages and not charge them a full $60–$70 for an unfinished product.

“Wardogs is ambitious, rough around the edges and still has a long way to go, but that is exactly what Early Access should be,” said Joe Brammer, CEO at Bulkhead. “We’re putting the game in players’ hands, listening to what they tell us and taking the risks needed to turn it into something that can last. More than anything, we want people to get online, talk to each other and have the kind of fun in an FPS that we grew up having.”

All of this suggests that Wardogs might be targeting 2028 for its 1.0 release, as PlayStation is extremely selective about early access titles on its platform, unlike Xbox. Major titles like Subnautica 2 have had to skip PS5 during early access, but there have been exceptions. However, I wouldn't hold my breath for Wardogs being one of those exceptions at the moment.

It's also interesting that Bulkhead specifically confirmed PS5 as a release platform, since PlayStation 6 is heavily speculated to release next year. Whether the game will also have a native PS6 version remains to be seen, but would presumably be playable on the next-gen console with backward compatibility should that be a supported feature.

Wardogs is one of the most surprising titles of 2026, as it really only emerged over the summer as marketing began to ramp up. However, the response from players who participated in playtests has been glowing and indicates the shooter space may have another big contender going forward.
